name: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila
short_description: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila is a half-marathon event on August 2, 2026, at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, Philippines.
ai_summary: EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 2, 2026, at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, Philippines. Organized by Runrio under the EastWest Dream Run brand, the event offers multiple distance options including 21.1km, 10km and 5km races, a 3km team race for groups of four and a 1km dog run.
pros: Five races, from a 1 km dog run and a 3 km for groups of four up to a 21 km
Relaxed 21 km field: a 2:41:47 median in 2026, with finishers out to 3:52
Every finisher gets a medal, towel and loot bag; 21 km finishers also get a shirt
Race village with a recovery lounge and more than P500,000 of raffle prizes in 2026
cons: 28°C with a 26°C dew point from the 3am start in 2026, with no cooling before 7am
No route map, gun times or cut-offs were published on the race pages
The 21 km and 5 km sold out before race day in 2026
Entries cannot be refunded, deferred or transferred

excerpt_quotes.quote: It was refreshing and fun—a nice reward after completing 5KM under the sun.
excerpt_quotes.attribution: Participant race report (Mommy Levy blog) on the 2025 Alabang/Manila leg

excerpt_quotes.quote: There's a genuine sense of heart behind the Dream Run. It's designed with thought, it's inclusive, and you can feel how personal the experience is for many runners

research_highlights: The Manila leg runs through Filinvest City, Alabang (Muntinlupa), which the organiser describes as green and walkable with tree-lined roads; start and finish were at the Filinvest Event Grounds.
Categories on offer are the 1K Dog Run, a 3K Group of 4, 5K, 10K and 21K; the 21K started at 3am, the 5K at 5am, the 3K at 5.30am and the dog run at 6am.

The 2026 Manila leg, the first of a four-city series in its second year, drew nearly 7,000 runners, families and dogs by the organiser's count; the results list 4,674 names across the five categories.
The post-race village had sponsor activities, games and a recovery lounge with massages, and the organiser gave away over P500,000 in raffle prizes.
Race organiser is RUNRIO, which measures its courses to RUNRIO standards, with course boundaries marked by barriers, traffic cones and other markings.
research_watchouts: Parking near the venue can be tight even for early arrivals — one 2025 participant found designated race parking still closed on arrival and had to park at a nearby hotel instead.
Race takes place in the heat of the Philippine morning sun; a 2025 participant specifically noted finishing 'under the sun' as a physical challenge.
The 2026 FAQ says an ambulance picks up all remaining runners on the route by the last cut-off time, and they are taken to the finish venue; the cut-off times themselves were not published.
No wheelchairs, bikes, skates, or strollers are permitted on the race route, which may affect participants planning to bring family with those items.

faqs.question: When is the EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila took place on Sunday 2 August 2026 at Filinvest Alabang in Muntinlupa, with the 21K and 10K starting at 3am. It was the opening leg of the 2026 series, which continued in Iloilo, while the Clark leg planned for 30 August was postponed because of the weather.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The race offers five categories: a 21.1km half marathon, which is the headline distance, a 10km, a 5km, a 3km team race for groups of four and a 1km dog run. Age limits apply, from 18 for the 21K to seven for the 3K group, and dog-run owners must be 18.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run 2026 - Manila takes place at Filinvest Alabang, located in the city of Muntinlupa, Philippines. This venue serves as the host site for all the distance categories offered during the event on August 2, 2026.

faqs.question: Who organizes the EastWest Dream Run?
faqs.answer: The EastWest Dream Run is organized by Runrio, which operates the event under the EastWest Dream Run brand name. Runrio manages the race details, including registration, venue coordination at Filinvest Alabang, and the multiple distance categories offered to participants.
